_comment: Hand edits for ranks 3,001+ of the Egyptian deck (tools/extend_deck_egyptian.py). Every lemma that passes the evidence gates was read once; this file holds the result. {"drop": true} removes a lemma (mis-lemmatised form, MSA-only literary word, name, vulgar); {"gloss", "pos", "posName"} replace the automatic values (CALIMA/Wiktionary glosses are noisy); {"vocalized"} replaces the CAMeL vocalisation; {"add": true, "vocalized", "gloss", "pos", "posName", "score"} appends an essential word the corpora mis-lemmatise or lack a gloss for (score = frequency proxy that sets its rank).
